title: XML cached read-only BLOB buffers leak at parser property retirement
summary: XML parser-owned cached RO BLOB item storage is not freed by generic property release, which intentionally frees only WO item payloads. Repeated upstream deletion/disconnect lifecycles can retain memory. Next: restrict cleanup fix to parser-owned cached properties, add deletion/disconnect leak regressions. Outside selected high-priority repair scope.
evidence: preliminary-review.md and parser developer report trace set_property allocation through delete/EOF indigo_release_property and bus permission-dependent cleanup. Source-contract confirmed, runtime leak reproduction not run.
